summary: Bind command cache credentials to the selected GitHub host

delivery.outcome: Prevent reuse of cached GitHub command results when only an unrelated host's explicit token is known, retaining safe cache hits and protected publication.
nonGoals: Do not access the system credential store, change provider transport, add dependencies, or alter the persistent cache schema.

architecture.decision: Select only explicit tokens appropriate for a known API host; when the host cannot be determined with certainty, cache only when both token classes are explicit.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert; cache schema and existing response identities remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: Synthetic mixed-host credential rotation bypasses cache, while safe explicit token requests still hit and rotate correctly.
